verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents migration paths from Pulley and Carta, a Spreadsheet Import feature, and team-assisted white-glove migration from another provider or a spreadsheet. That covers the migrate-and-guided-import half of the story. The evidence consists mostly of article titles and marketing lines, and nothing describes import validation or reconciliation against source documents. missing for 10: documented import validation/error checking, reconciliation of imported data against source documents, step-level detail of the import workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration of migration quality
